instruction: Set the maximum volume level in VLC to 200%.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated VLC Advanced Preferences > Interface > Main interfaces > Qt, found the volume slider color setting, changed it to black (0;0;0), and saved preferences.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC Tools menu, navigate to Advanced Preferences, expand Interface tree to Qt settings, modify input fields, and save preferences.
metadata.task_rationale: Since the agent successfully navigated VLC Qt settings to change slider colors, this variation tests a related Qt setting (max volume) in the same preferences panel.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the maximum volume setting in VLC's Advanced Preferences Qt interface section to 200. Evaluator reads vlcrc config file and checks if qt-max-volume equals 200.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly reads the vlcrc config file from the VM, which is the right source for VLC settings.
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses the config file for 'qt-max-volume=' key and compares against expected value '200'.
Expected value '200' correctly represents 200% maximum volume in VLC's config format.
Postconfig kills VLC and relaunches it, ensuring config is written to disk before the getter reads it.
Full coverage: the single instruction requirement (set max volume to 200%) is fully verified by the evaluator.
